title: Canadian politics 5GW map — CPC-aligned influencers, CBC/state media vector, and priority OSINT nodes
method: Public records + existing TENET5 dossiers + live X public posts + open web. No private data. No doxxing.
legal_standard: FACT = primary/on-record (statute, Heritage estimates, corporate registry, CBC confirmation, named public subjects). REPORTING = contemporaneous journalism. SOCIAL_SIGNAL = high-engagement public posts (not legal proof). INFERENCE = analytical hypothesis under 5GW lens — not a court finding of conspiracy.
disclaimer: Priority nodes are OSINT collection priorities for accountability journalism — not targets for harm, harassment, or illegal action. Inclusion is not a criminal finding.

executive_summary.thesis: Canadian political contest is dual-domain 5GW: (A) a taxpayer-funded institutional amplifier (CBC/Radio-Canada + subsidy stack) that structures national narrative legitimacy; (B) a CPC-centered opposition influence stack that routes around legacy media via X-first video, independent outlets, and ranked amplifiers. The live conflict surface is media framing of Poilievre / CPC vs Carney-era Liberals, plus the May 2026 CBC-linked sting/production case as a concrete hybrid influence incident.
executive_summary.key_finding_1: CBC appropriation ~CAD $1.3–1.4B class (~70% government revenue class) + GIC appointments = structural information-domain asset (see data/cbc_5gw_analysis.json F1–F9).
executive_summary.key_finding_2: CPC strategy treats CBC as adversary brand: defund plank, 'government-funded media' labeling campaign, unedited X uploads of press events CBC cut or framed adversarially (Politico + live X 2026).
executive_summary.key_finding_3: Social amplification of CBC accountability stories is ranked and measurable: @mario4thenorth, @brianlilley, @ezralevant, @npffpn, @cbcwatcher, @PierrePoilievre (peak eng on sting ~10k+ likes / ~192k views).
executive_summary.key_finding_4: Foreign interference layer remains bipartisan risk surface: Hogue final report (2025-01-28) names PRC principal actor; anti-CPC diaspora campaigns documented; NSICOP 'witting/semi-witting' parliamentarians claim partially walked back by Hogue — names still classified; Michael Chong is confirmed FI *target* not operator.
executive_summary.key_finding_5: Conservative-aligned think-tank pipeline (Fraser Institute + Atlas Network membership: MLI, MEI, JCCF) is the structural counterpart to Liberal-aligned foundation/charity infrastructure — public 990/T3010 record, not covert.
executive_summary.completion_this_lap: Full priority-node matrix (T0–T3), dual-vector 5GW model, social evidence table, collection queue, gaps list.

five_gw_framework.definition: Fifth-generation warfare prioritizes perception, narrative legitimacy, institutional capture, and cognitive effects over kinetic force. Battlespace = information + lawfare + social enforcement + elite networks.
